captions.detailed: An industrial floor-standing air scrubber featuring a tall, rectangular grey cabinet mounted on small black caster wheels. The front of the unit has a large hinged access door that swings open on revolute hinges located along the left edge. On the top of the cabinet, there is a secondary rectangular exhaust baffle that pivots on a rear-mounted revolute hinge, revealing an exhaust opening beneath.
captions.instruction: Create an industrial floor-standing air scrubber with a tall rectangular cabinet on caster wheels. It should feature a large hinged front access door on two revolute hinges at the left edge, and a secondary hinged exhaust baffle at the cabinet top on a revolute hinge at the rear edge.
captions.factory: The code constructs a base cabinet using a hollowed-out box primitive with a front cutout and a top exhaust opening. Small cylinder primitives are positioned underneath to represent caster wheels. A front door is constructed as a flat plate with a handle and hinge knuckles, connected to the cabinet via a revolute joint on the left edge. A top exhaust baffle is modeled as a shallow tray with hinge pins, connected to the top of the cabinet via a second revolute joint at the rear edge.
